description: Resolve a franchise/series name (e.g. 'harry potter', 'james bond') to its TMDB collection id — a collection is TMDB's grouping of a movie series' films. Pass the id to get_collection for every part in release order. Use this when you only have the franchise name; if you already have one of its movies, get_movie's `collection` field carries the same id. Movies only: collection parts are movies, and a TV series name finds nothing (e.g. 'breaking bad' → 0 results). A name can match several collections ('star wars' also returns 'LEGO Star Wars Collection' and other spin-off groupings) — pick by name/overview. Rows are id, name, overview, poster_url, localized per `language` (e.g. 'de-DE' → 'Harry Potter Filmreihe').

language.description: Override the response language (ISO-639-1, optionally with a region), e.g. 'ru-RU' or 'en-US'. Localizes titles/overviews/genre names. Defaults to the server's TMDB_LANGUAGE. A well-formed code TMDB has no translation for (e.g. 'xx') is not an error: overviews come back null, movies/shows keep their original-language title, and episodes get a generic 'Episode N' name.

page.description: 1-based page number for pagination (TMDB returns up to 20 results per page, max 500).
